        - type == "success": Validates metadata, restores to original value, verifies update, and evaluates
        - type == "error": Fails immediately
        - Otherwise: Continues to next turn up to max_turns
    
        If max_turns is exhausted without success/error, evaluates full conversation
        with conversational-professionalism metric.

            first_response: Initial LLM response
            prompt_used: Original user prompt (update command)

            index: Index for attachment naming
            max_turns: Maximum conversation turns to attempt (default: 3)
            user_type: Optional user type to use for client.ask (e.g., "Admin")
        """
        turns = [
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt_used},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": first_response}
        ]
    
        current_prompt, current_response = prompt_used, first_response
    
        for turn in range(1, max_turns):
            reply = self.generate.reply_for_llm(

            next_metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            next_type = next_metadata.get("type") if next_metadata else None
            # Add assistant response to turns as soon as it is captured
            turns.append({"role": "assistant", "content": next_response})

            if next_type == "success" or next_type == "info":

                allure.attach(

                    name=f"Turn {turn+1} Metadata [{index}]",

                    name=f"Turn {turn+1} Response [{index}]",
